name: Identify and describe specific chemical compounds and materials
description: Users asked to identify, define, or describe specific chemical compounds, minerals, and elements, often including fictional substances, by providing their names, properties, or formula interpretations. They frequently requested brief summaries or clarifications of these substances' structures, hazards, and classifications based on given structural or textual cues.
